import os,sys,json,time,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=Path('/tmp/spacr-implementation-20261001/merges')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo))
root=base/'backends';root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
scope=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().split('::',1)[1].strip().lstrip('/')
record={'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),'cpu_affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'free_disk_bytes':shutil.disk_usage(base).free,'limits':{k:(scope/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.max','memory.swap.max')}}
assert record['free_disk_bytes']>10*1024**3
from spacr import _segmentation_backends as sb
started=time.monotonic()
try:
    state=sb._install_backend('microsam',root=str(root),torch_index='https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu',progress=lambda step,total,text: print(f'{step}/{total}: {text}',flush=True))
    record.update(ready=state.ready,state=state.state,environment=state.env,marker=state.record)
    assert state.ready
except BaseException as exc:
    record['error']=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
    raise
finally:
    record.update(seconds=time.monotonic()-started,resources={k:(scope/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.peak','memory.events')})
    (base/'install-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)

import os,sys,time,json,hashlib,shutil,dataclasses
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out=base/'gui';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for key,folder in [('XDG_CONFIG_HOME','config'),('XDG_CACHE_HOME','cache'),('MPLCONFIGDIR','mpl')]:
    path=out/folder;path.mkdir();os.environ[key]=str(path)
os.environ['SPACR_BACKENDS_DIR']=str(base/'backends')
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/spacr-implementation-20261001/merges')
import numpy as np
import tifffile
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication,QWidget,QVBoxLayout
from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF,Qt
from spacr.qt import preferences,theme,mask_engine
from spacr.qt.screens.make_masks import MakeMasksScreen
from spacr import _segmentation_backends as sb
scope=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().split('::',1)[1].strip().lstrip('/')
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
        for c in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(c)
    return h.hexdigest()
source=Path('/media/carruthers/mnt3/spacr-f551-20261002/stardist_demo/nuclei.tif')
truth=source.with_name('nuclei_labels.tif')
field=out/'field';field.mkdir();shutil.copyfile(source,field/source.name)
gt=tifffile.imread(truth)
record={'source':str(source),'source_sha256':sha(source),'truth':str(truth),'truth_sha256':sha(truth),'shape':list(gt.shape),'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'network_namespace':os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),'limits':{k:(scope/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.max','memory.swap.max')},'prompts':[]}
app=QApplication([])
preferences._get_show_alpha_features=lambda:True
host=QWidget();host.setAutoFillBackground(True);layout=QVBoxLayout(host)
screen=MakeMasksScreen();layout.addWidget(screen)
theme.apply_qpalette(app);app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet())
host.resize(1560,1050);host.show()
errors=[]
screen._prompter.said.connect(lambda text,kind: errors.append(text) if kind=='error' else None)
def process():
    app.processEvents()
def wait(predicate,limit=1800):
    start=time.monotonic()
    while not predicate():
        process()
        if errors:raise RuntimeError(errors[-1])
        if time.monotonic()-start>limit:raise TimeoutError(screen._masks_console.text())
        time.sleep(.002)
    process()
def point(y,x):
    return QPointF(screen._canvas._image_to_canvas(x+.5,y+.5))
def submit(y,x,positive=True):
    old=screen._prompter.pending
    pos=point(int(y),int(x));button=Qt.LeftButton if positive else Qt.RightButton
    start=time.monotonic()
    assert screen._prompter.press(button,pos)
    assert screen._prompter.release(button,pos)
    wait(lambda:screen._prompter.pending is not None and screen._prompter.pending is not old)
    pending=screen._prompter.pending
    row={k:v for k,v in pending.items() if k!='mask'}
    row.update(click_to_preview_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,pixels=int(pending['mask'].sum()))
    record['prompts'].append(row)
    print('PROMPT '+json.dumps(row,default=str),flush=True)
    return pending['mask'].copy()
try:
    screen._open_folder(str(field));process();screen._canvas.refresh();process()
    assert screen._canvas.mask is not None and not screen._canvas.mask.any()
    assert screen._prompt_ready()
    screen._btn_prompt.setChecked(True);assert screen._prompter.enabled
    counts=np.bincount(gt.ravel().astype(int));counts[0]=0;label=int(counts.argmax())
    target=gt==label;dist=distance_transform_edt(target)
    y,x=np.unravel_index(dist.argmax(),dist.shape)
    record['target_reference_label']=label
    first=submit(y,x)
    assert first.any() and first[y,x]
    assert record['prompts'][0]['embed_seconds'] is not None
    ys,xs=np.where(target & (dist>2));far=((ys-y)**2+(xs-x)**2).argmax()
    positive=submit(ys[far],xs[far])
    assert record['prompts'][-1]['embed_seconds'] is None
    candidates=positive & ~target
    if not candidates.any():
        candidates=positive.copy();candidates[max(0,y-3):y+4,max(0,x-3):x+4]=False
    ny,nx=np.unravel_index(distance_transform_edt(candidates).argmax(),candidates.shape)
    assert candidates[ny,nx]
    negative=submit(ny,nx,False)
    record['negative_refinement_changed_pixels']=int(np.count_nonzero(positive!=negative))
    record['negative_prompt_excluded']=not bool(negative[ny,nx])
    assert record['negative_refinement_changed_pixels']>0
    assert record['negative_prompt_excluded']
    # Genuine box drag through the same canvas prompt handlers.
    ys,xs=np.where(target);y0,x0=max(0,int(ys.min())-3),max(0,int(xs.min())-3)
    y1,x1=min(gt.shape[0]-1,int(ys.max())+3),min(gt.shape[1]-1,int(xs.max())+3)
    old=screen._prompter.pending;start=time.monotonic()
    assert screen._prompter.press(Qt.LeftButton,point(y0,x0))
    assert screen._prompter.move(point(y1,x1))
    assert screen._prompter.release(Qt.LeftButton,point(y1,x1))
    wait(lambda:screen._prompter.pending is not None and screen._prompter.pending is not old)
    pending=screen._prompter.pending;expected=pending['mask'].copy()
    record['box_prompt']={k:v for k,v in pending.items() if k!='mask'}
    record['box_prompt']['click_to_preview_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
    assert pending['box'] is not None and pending['embed_seconds'] is None and expected.any()
    assert not screen._canvas.mask.any(),'Unaccepted prediction mutated label image'
    assert screen._prompter.key(Qt.Key_Return)
    saved_labels=screen._canvas.mask.copy();assert np.array_equal(saved_labels>0,expected)
    entry=screen._log.edits[-1]
    record['edit']=dataclasses.asdict(entry)
    assert entry.kind=='prompt' and entry.detail['tool']=='micro-SAM'
    assert entry.detail['points'][-1][2] is False and entry.detail['box'] is not None
    assert entry.detail['device']=='cpu' and entry.detail['versions']['micro_sam']=='1.8.14'
    screen._on_save();process()
    saved=Path(mask_engine.mask_save_path(screen._folder,source.name,**screen._layout_kwargs()))
    assert saved.exists() and np.array_equal(tifffile.imread(saved),saved_labels)
    record.update(saved_mask=str(saved),saved_sha256=sha(saved),saved_pixels=int((saved_labels>0).sum()),accepted_labels=[int(v) for v in np.unique(saved_labels) if v])
    screen._on_undo();assert not screen._canvas.mask.any()
    screen._on_redo();assert np.array_equal(screen._canvas.mask,saved_labels)
    screen._on_save();process()
    record['undo_redo_verified']=True
    host.grab().save(str(out/'accepted-dark.png'))
    theme.apply_qpalette(app,'light');app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet('light'));process()
    host.grab().save(str(out/'accepted-light.png'))
    record['source_unchanged']=sha(source)==record['source_sha256'] and sha(truth)==record['truth_sha256']
    assert record['source_unchanged']
    record['all_cached_clicks_under_one_second']=all(p['click_to_preview_seconds']<1 for p in record['prompts'][1:])
    record['passed']=record['all_cached_clicks_under_one_second']
    print('ACCEPTANCE '+json.dumps(record,default=str),flush=True)
finally:
    screen._prompter.close();sb._shutdown_workers()
    record['resources']={k:(scope/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.peak','memory.events')}
    record['errors']=errors
    (out/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,default=str)+'\n')
assert record.get('passed'),record

import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ['XDG_CONFIG_HOME']=str(base/'capture-config')
os.environ['SPACR_BACKENDS_DIR']=str(base/'backends')
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/spacr-implementation-20261001/merges')
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication,QWidget,QVBoxLayout,QScrollArea
from spacr.qt import theme,preferences
from spacr.qt.screens.make_masks import MakeMasksScreen
app=QApplication([])
preferences._get_show_alpha_features=lambda:True
for name,color in [('dark','#141618'),('light','#f6f7fa')]:
    preferences.set_theme(name)
    host=QWidget();host.setObjectName('AcceptanceHost');host.setStyleSheet('#AcceptanceHost { background: '+color+'; }')
    layout=QVBoxLayout(host);screen=MakeMasksScreen();layout.addWidget(screen)
    theme.apply_qpalette(app,name);app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet(name))
    host.resize(1560,1050);host.show()
    screen._open_folder(str(base/'gui/field'))
    for _ in range(10):app.processEvents()
    ancestor=screen._prompt_card.parentWidget()
    while ancestor is not None and not isinstance(ancestor,QScrollArea):ancestor=ancestor.parentWidget()
    assert ancestor is not None
    ancestor.ensureWidgetVisible(screen._prompt_card,0,20)
    ancestor.horizontalScrollBar().setValue(0)
    for _ in range(10):app.processEvents()
    assert host.grab().save(str(base/'gui'/f'accepted-framed-{name}.png'))
    screen._prompter.close();host.deleteLater();app.processEvents()
print('Both opaque-parent theme captures completed without inference.')
